en.title: Glass Gears and the Pilgrimage of the Void
en.premise: I live in this city of mist as a 'Repairer,' one who sets stopped time back in motion. One day, a broken pocket watch whose hands spin relentlessly backward was brought to me. The moment I touched it, the cityscape warped, and 'another version of myself'—who should have been trapped within a mirror—spoke to me in a voice laden with the heat of steam. This is a journey through memories where logic melts away, until the hands of the clock finally reach the true midnight.

zh.title: 硝子的齿轮与空虚时刻的巡礼
zh.premise: 我作为一名让停止的时间重新运转的『修复师』，居住在这座迷雾之城。某一天，有人给我带来了一块指针不断逆向旋转的破损怀表。在触碰到那块表的瞬间，城市的景色发生了扭曲，本应被囚禁在镜中的『另一个我』，用带着蒸汽热度的声音对我低语。这是一场在时针抵达真正的零点之前，逻辑逐渐融化的记忆之旅。
